an3.93:2.2: All are extremely uncomfortable. Christian ascetics wore a “hair shirt” in order to “mortify the flesh”. Before awakening, Gotama undertook this practice ([mn12:45.7]()).
an3.93:3.2: It is difficult to distinguish the various types of grain. This practice was also undertaken by Gotama before awakening ([mn12:45.6]()).
an3.93:4.2: Excepting the final item, these are all standard places recommend for meditation. | The final item, “threshing hut” is unique in this context, and is not normally recommended by the Buddha for meditation (or dwelling). Nonetheless, the Buddha did stay one time in a threshing hut ([dn16:4.30.1]()).
